work.note: The Intern é uma comédia americana de 2015 sobre uma jovem chefe de uma empresa de moda online e um estagiário idoso. Mostra e-mails, reuniões e dias cheios. Na aula, a Sara conta um dia online: “I was talking to a client.” A cena desta aula é original; não reproduz a obra.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação em andamento e when + passado simples para a que interrompe: I was writing an email when the call started.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Use was/were + verbo -ing para uma ação que estava em andamento no passado: I was talking to a client. They were working. Use was com I, he, she e it; use were com you, we e they.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when para a ação curta que interrompe: I was writing an email when the call started. A parte com when usa o passado simples. A outra parte usa was/were + -ing.

pages.title: A busy office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday at noon in a busy office in Atlanta. Phones ring and keyboards click. Sara sits at her desk with a headset. Her coworker Paul comes by with a coffee. Both of them have a long list of tasks. Paul asks about her message.
“Hi, Sara! Why didn’t you answer my message?” says Paul. “I was talking to a client when you wrote.” says Sara. “Oh, I see. Were you using video?” says Paul.
